english.title: Fail to comply with an information notice re packaging waste - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement of an information notice issued by Natural Resources Wales under regulation 23 of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023, in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 28(5) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationwithout reasonable excusefailed to comply with a requirement of an information notice issued by Natural Resources Wales under regulation 23

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Please note, there is an error in regulation 28(5) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023 which creates this offence. Regulation 28(5) refers to regulation 24(2) however, this appears to be an error and should in fact state regulation 23(2) which sets out provisions regarding a written notice as per the offence wording and details above.
